info.title: ACME Bank Dispute Portal API
info.description: Transactions (debit orders and card), mandates, disputes and notifications for the signed-in customer, and the dispute review queue for bank agents. All endpoints under /api require a Keycloak access token: with the 'agent' role under /api/v1/agent, and with the 'customer' role everywhere else. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents with a stable 'code' and a 'traceId'.

get.summary: Lists disputes across all customers. By default the review queue: disputes waiting for review first, oldest first.
Returns one dispute with the disputed transaction, the audit trail of who did what, and the comment thread.

post.summary: Approves a dispute that waits for review, which sends it for processing. Returns 409 if it was already reviewed or withdrawn.
Rejects a dispute that waits for review. The reason is shown to the customer as the outcome. Returns 409 if it was already reviewed or withdrawn.
Adds an agent's comment to a dispute while it is open. The customer is notified in their inbox. Returns 409 once the dispute is closed.
Raises a dispute against a debit order or a card transaction, with an optional comment. Requires an Idempotency-Key header, which makes retries safe.

get.summary: Lists the customer's disputes, newest first. Filter by state to get pending or completed disputes.
Returns one dispute with its progress timeline and its comment thread.

post.summary: Withdraws the customer's own dispute while it still waits for review. Returns 409 once it has been reviewed.
Adds a comment to the customer's own dispute while it is open. Returns 409 once the dispute is refunded, declined or withdrawn.

get.summary: Lists the dispute reasons the customer can choose for one of their transactions, each with the scheme's code for it.
Lists the customer's inbox, newest first.
Returns how many notifications the customer has not read.

post.summary: Marks a notification as read. Safe to repeat.

get.summary: Lists the customer's debit order mandates, optionally by type.
Lists the customer's transactions of one type, newest first, with whether each can be disputed.
Returns one transaction with the details of its type and its dispute eligibility.

bearer.description: A Keycloak access token for a user with the 'customer' role, or the 'agent' role for the agent endpoints.
